speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing swelling in your right knee and have a family history of similar issues; to begin our evaluation, can you describe exactly how the swelling started and if you experienced any injury at the time?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A. 

*Note: The patient is an 18-month-old male with spontaneous right knee swelling after minor activity and a family history, which is highly suggestive of a congenital bleeding disorder like hemophilia. Spontaneous hemarthrosis (joint bleeding) in this context is a classic presentation.*
